'''Julie Ann Borchers''' (born 1962) is an American physicist.

== Education ==
Borchers received her B.S. in physics at the [[University of Dayton]] in 1984. She completed a Ph.D. at [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign]] in 1990.<ref name=":0" /> Borcher's doctoral advisor was [[Myron Salamon]]. Her dissertation was titled ''Structural and magnetic properties of erbium thin films and Er/Y superlattices''.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Structural and magnetic properties of erbium thin films and Er/Y superlattices|date=1990|language=English|first=Julie Ann|last=Borchers|oclc=27905859}}</ref>

== Career and research ==
Borchers is part of the Neutron-Condensed Matter Science Group at the [[National Institute of Standards and Technology]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nist.gov/people/julie-borchers|title=Julie A. Borchers|last=Borchers|first=Julie A.|date=2019-10-09|website=NIST|language=en|access-date=2019-10-15}}</ref> She works as associate director for the Center for High Resolution Neutron Scattering (CHRNS) and is an instrument scientist for the polarized beam reflectometer (PBR).<ref name=":0" />

She acts as chair-elect for the [[American Physical Society|APS]] Topical Group on Magnetism and its Applications (GMAG), working on bringing together students, scientists and engineers to advance the study and applications of magnetism.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Dove|first=Abigail|title=The APS Topical Group on Magnetism and its Applications|url=http://www.aps.org/publications/apsnews/202011/gmag.cfm|access-date=2021-03-15|website=www.aps.org|language=en}}</ref> Her term as chair-elect is May 2020 to March 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Executive Committee Members|url=https://engage.aps.org/gmag/governance/executive-committee/committee-members?Execute=1|access-date=2021-03-14|website=aps.org}}</ref> 

== Awards and honours ==
She was elected a  [[Fellow of the American Physical Society]] in 2002.<ref> {{cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=B&year=2002&unit_id=&institution=|title=APS Fellow Archive|publisher=APS|accessdate=17 September 2020}} </ref>

She was awarded [[National Institute of Standards and Technology|NIST]] 2022 Distinguished Mentoring Award.<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2022-10-19 |title=2022 - Distinguished Mentoring Award---Julie Borchers |url=https://www.nist.gov/nist-awards/2022-distinguished-mentoring-award-julie-borchers |journal=NIST |language=en}}</ref>
